from inspect import signature
def get_spec(func, _cache={}):
    func = getattr(func, '__original__', None) or unwrap(func)
    try:
        return _cache[func]
    except KeyError:
        pass
    # introspection
    try:
        sig = signature(func)
    except ValueError:
        # builtins maybe
        # fallback to old logic
    else:
        params = sig.parameters
        required_names = set()
        optional_params = 0
        has_varargs = False
        for name, p in params.items():
            if p.kind == p.VAR_POSITIONAL:
                has_varargs = True
                continue
            if p.default is p.empty:
                required_names.add(name)
            else:
                optional_params += 1
        required_n = len(required_names)
        max_n = required_n + optional_params + (1 if has_varargs else 0)
        spec = (required_names, required_n, max_n)
        _cache[func] = spec
        return spec
```

    original = getattr(func, '__original__', None) or unwrap(func)
    argnames = get_argnames(original)
    indexes = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(argnames)}
    defaults = {}
    for name, param in inspect.signature(original).parameters.items():
        if param.kind in (param.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD, param.KEYWORD_ONLY) and param.default is not param.empty:
            defaults[name] = param.default
    def get_arg(name, args, kwargs):
        if name not in indexes:
            raise TypeError(...)
        index = indexes[name]
        if index < len(args):
            return args[index]
        elif name in kwargs:
            return kwargs[name]
        elif name in defaults:
            return defaults[name]
        else:
            raise TypeError(...)
    _cache[func] = get_arg
    return get_arg
